name: Package verification
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm ci --prefix v2 --ignore-scripts
      - run: node --test scripts/test/*.test.mjs
      - run: npm test --prefix v2
      - run: npm audit --prefix v2 --audit-level=high
      - run: find v2/src -name '*.mjs' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
      - run: node v2/src/index.mjs optimize status
      - name: Verify skills and native Claude plugin
        run: |
          npm install --global --ignore-scripts @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.283
          node "$(npm root --global)/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/install.cjs"
          node scripts/plugin-e2e.mjs
      - name: Verify packed CLI
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cp README.md v2/README.md
          npm pack ./v2 --pack-destination dist --json > /tmp/pack.json
          TARBALL=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/tmp/pack.json'))[0].filename")
          node scripts/package-e2e.mjs "$PWD/dist/$TARBALL"

name: Nightly Verified Release
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force_release:
        description: Run even if upstream version is unchanged
        type: boolean
        default: false
      channel:
        description: npm distribution tag
        type: choice
        options: [nightly, latest]
        default: nightly
permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write
concurrency:
  group: nightly-verified-release
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: true
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - name: Detect upstream and select immutable candidate
        id: candidate
        env:
          FORCE: ${{ inputs.force_release }}
          CHANNEL: ${{ inputs.channel || 'nightly' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${GITHUB_REF}" = refs/heads/main
          NEW=$(npm view @anthropic-ai/claude-code version)
          PREV=$(cat scripts/last-decompiled-claude-version.txt)
          [[ "$NEW" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
          [[ "$PREV" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
          echo "new=$NEW" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "prev=$PREV" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$NEW" = "$PREV" ] && [ "$FORCE" != true ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "No upstream change; verification and publication were not run." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            exit 0
          fi
          BASE=$(node -p "require('./v2/package.json').version")
          VERSION="$BASE"
          if [ "$CHANNEL" = nightly ]; then
            VERSION="$BASE-nightly.$(date -u +%Y%m%d).${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}"
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          cd v2
          npm version "$VERSION" --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version
      - name: Install locked dependencies
        if: steps.candidate.outputs.run == 'true'
        working-directory: v2
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Regression, security and syntax gates
        if: steps.candidate.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --test scripts/test/*.test.mjs
          npm test --prefix v2
          npm audit --prefix v2 --audit-level=high
          find v2/src -name '*.mjs' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
          node v2/src/index.mjs optimize status
      - name: Verify skills and native Claude plugin
        if: steps.candidate.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: |
          npm install --global --ignore-scripts @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.283
          node "$(npm root --global)/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/install.cjs"
          node scripts/plugin-e2e.mjs
      - name: Recover and validate both upstream sources
        if: steps.candidate.outputs.run == 'true'
        env:
          NEW: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.new }}
          PREV: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.prev }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/decompile-and-diff.mjs "$NEW" "$PREV" --output-dir /tmp/decompile-output > /tmp/decompile-diff.json
          node scripts/validate-decompile-diff.mjs /tmp/decompile-diff.json "$NEW" "$PREV"
          python3 scripts/format-diff-summary.py /tmp/decompile-diff.json "$PREV" "$NEW" > /tmp/discovery-summary.md
      - name: AI analysis must succeed
        if: steps.candidate.outputs.run == 'true'
        env:
          AI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AI_API_KEY }}
          AI_BASE_URL: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
          AI_MODEL: openai/gpt-4.1-mini
          NEW: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.new }}
          PREV: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.prev }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash scripts/analyze-discoveries.sh "$NEW" "$PREV" > /tmp/ai-summary.md
          cat /tmp/ai-summary.md >> /tmp/discovery-summary.md
      - name: Record evidence based capability proposals
        if: steps.candidate.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: node scripts/auto-update-capabilities.mjs /tmp/decompile-diff.json > /tmp/capability-proposals.json
      - name: Pack and exercise installed artifact
        if: steps.candidate.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p dist
          cp README.md v2/README.md
          npm pack ./v2 --pack-destination dist --json > /tmp/pack.json
          TARBALL=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/tmp/pack.json'))[0].filename")
          node scripts/package-e2e.mjs "$PWD/dist/$TARBALL"
          node scripts/release-receipt.mjs /tmp/pack.json "$GITHUB_SHA" > dist/receipt.json
      - name: Live provider tool roundtrip on packed artifact
        if: steps.candidate.outputs.run == 'true'
        env:
          AI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AI_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          TARBALL=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/tmp/pack.json'))[0].filename")
          node scripts/live-package-e2e.mjs "$PWD/dist/$TARBALL"
      - name: Publish exact tested tarball and verify registry integrity
        if: steps.candidate.outputs.run == 'true'
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          CHANNEL: ${{ inputs.channel || 'nightly' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$NODE_AUTH_TOKEN"
          node scripts/publish-verified.mjs /tmp/pack.json dist "$CHANNEL"
      - name: Verify fresh installation from npm
        if: steps.candidate.outputs.run == 'true'
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.version }}
        run: node scripts/package-e2e.mjs "@ruvnet/open-claude-code@$VERSION"
      - name: Publish GitHub release with evidence
        if: steps.candidate.outputs.run == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.version }}
          CHANNEL: ${{ inputs.channel || 'nightly' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cp /tmp/capability-proposals.json dist/
          cp /tmp/discovery-summary.md dist/
          if ! gh release view "v$VERSION" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            ARGS=()
            if [ "$CHANNEL" = nightly ]; then ARGS+=(--prerelease); fi
            gh release create "v$VERSION" dist/* --target "$GITHUB_SHA" --title "Verified release $VERSION" --notes-file /tmp/discovery-summary.md "${ARGS[@]}"
          fi
          echo "Published @ruvnet/open-claude-code@$VERSION from $GITHUB_SHA. AI proposals are review evidence, not implemented features." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Advance upstream checkpoint only after publication
        if: steps.candidate.outputs.run == 'true'
        env:
          NEW: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.new }}
          PREV: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.prev }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git restore v2/package.json v2/package-lock.json
          git fetch origin main
          git switch --detach origin/main
          CURRENT=$(cat scripts/last-decompiled-claude-version.txt)
          if [ "$CURRENT" != "$PREV" ] && [ "$CURRENT" != "$NEW" ]; then
            echo "Checkpoint advanced concurrently; refusing to overwrite it" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          echo "$NEW" > scripts/last-known-claude-version.txt
          echo "$NEW" > scripts/last-decompiled-claude-version.txt
          git add scripts/last-known-claude-version.txt scripts/last-decompiled-claude-version.txt
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore: record verified upstream $NEW"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi
      - name: Retain release evidence
        if: always() && steps.candidate.outputs.run == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-evidence
          path: |
            dist/
            /tmp/decompile-diff.json
            /tmp/ai-summary.md
            /tmp/capability-proposals.json
          retention-days: 90
  failure:
    needs: release
    if: failure()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Report failed release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: gh issue create --title "Verified release failed (run ${{ github.run_id }})" --body "Required release gate failed. Inspect $RUN_URL. No capability or publication success should be inferred from a partial run."

Open Claude Code

Open Source Claude Code CLI — Reverse Engineered & Rebuilt

![Verified release pipeline: detect, validate, test, publish](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruvnet/open-claude-code/main/assets/verified-release-flow.svg)

An open source implementation of Anthropic's Claude Code CLI,
built from decompiled source intelligence using ruDevolution.

> **Release automation:** The nightly workflow gates publication on source validation, tests, AI analysis, and registry checks. A successful run is the evidence of completion; failed runs do not advance checkpoints. Capability proposals require review before implementation. See the release workflow and ADR-004. --- ## ⚡ Quick Start ```bash # Run instantly (no install) npx @ruvnet/open-claude-code "explain this codebase" # Or install globally npm install -g @ruvnet/open-claude-code occ "hello" # Interactive mode occ ``` **Requires:** `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable set. ```bash export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... npx @ruvnet/open-claude-code "what files are in this directory?" ``` --- ## Skills and Claude Code plugin Three shared skills cover CLI usage, diagnosis, and release verification. Choose one installation method to avoid duplicate skills. ### Install with npx skills The tested skills installer requires Node 22.20 or newer (Node 24 recommended). OCC itself requires Node 20 or newer. ```bash npx skills@1.7.2 add ruvnet/open-claude-code --agent claude-code --skill occ-use occ-diagnose occ-verify-release ``` OCC 2.1.2 also loads these project skills from `.claude/skills`, including the installer's symlinks. Project skills override user skills. Invoke them with OCC's Skill tool or slash commands. ### Install the native Claude Code plugin In Claude Code: ```text /plugin marketplace add ruvnet/open-claude-code /plugin install occ@ruvnet-occ /occ:occ-use /occ:occ-diagnose /occ:occ-verify-release ``` Restart Claude Code after installation if the current session has not loaded the new skills. ```bash claude plugin update occ@ruvnet-occ claude plugin uninstall occ@ruvnet-occ ``` The `occ` plugin uses the same `skills/` sources. It installs no hooks, MCP servers, credentials, or background processes. It guides use of the separately published CLI. This native Claude Code package does not imply compatibility between OCC's custom PluginLoader and all third party Claude plugins. ### Reproduce installation tests ```bash # From a repository checkout, with Node 24 and Claude Code installed: node scripts/plugin-e2e.mjs # Test public GitHub distribution after publishing: node scripts/plugin-e2e.mjs ruvnet/open-claude-code ``` The suite installs and removes real skills and plugins in disposable profiles, checks all three Claude skill expansions with a local model fixture, and verifies OCC discovery. Live provider behavior is tested separately by `scripts/live-package-e2e.mjs`. Tested installer: skills 1.7.2; Claude Code: 2.1.283. ## Upstream behavior fixes in 2.1.3 Implemented and tested against the public [Claude Code 2.1.295 and 2.1.296 changelog](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): | Behavior | OCC support | | --- | --- | | Hook failure policy | Command and HTTP hooks honor `onFailure: "block"`; exit 2 vetoes execution | | PreToolUse veto | `continue: false` and structured deny block the call and return an error result to the next model turn | | PostToolUse MCP output | `updatedMCPToolOutput` replaces results for MCP tool names | | Large text reads | `Read.allow_large: true` bypasses the implicit 2,000 line limit; explicit offset/limit remain active | | Encoding safety | Edit, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit reject invalid UTF8 before any write | | Delegation safety | Child tools intersect parent tools and inherit permission checks and hooks | | Model call budget | `--max-turns` limits model requests, including tool continuations | Large text reads have hard ceilings of 16 MiB and 100,000 lines. HTTP hook responses have a 1 MiB limit. Typed hook timeouts use seconds; legacy flat hook timeouts retain milliseconds. Plain command stdout remains supported. Subagents default to at most 10 model calls, delegation depth 2 (hard maximum 3), and at most 4 running background agents. An explicit empty child tool list grants no tools. Worktree isolation requests are rejected until isolation is implemented. Prompt and agent hook evaluators, asynchronous hooks, complete session/checkpoint lifecycle wiring, and full provider parity remain outside this release. See [ADR-006](docs/adr/ADR-006-upstream-behavioral-contracts.md). The [lifecycle issue](https://github.com/ruvnet/open-claude-code/issues/17) remains open for those gaps. ## 🧠 What Is This? **Open Claude Code** is a ground-up open source rebuild of Anthropic's [Claude Code CLI](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code), informed by [ruDevolution's](https://github.com/ruvnet/rudevolution) AI-powered decompilation of the published npm package. It's not a copy — it's a clean-room implementation that mirrors the actual Claude Code architecture: async generator agent loop, 25 tools, 4 MCP transports, 6 permission modes, hooks, settings chain, sessions, and more. **1,008 unit tests plus installed-package behavioral checks. Full upstream parity is not established.** --- ## 📦 Installation ### npx (no install needed) ```bash npx @ruvnet/open-claude-code "your prompt here" ``` ### Global install ```bash npm install -g @ruvnet/open-claude-code occ "your prompt here" ``` ### From source ```bash git clone https://github.com/ruvnet/open-claude-code.git cd open-claude-code/v2 export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... node src/index.mjs "hello" ``` --- ## 🖥️ Usage ### One-shot mode ```bash occ "explain the auth module" occ "fix the bug in server.js" occ "create a REST API for user management" occ "find all TODO comments in this project" ``` ### Interactive REPL ```bash occ # > explain this codebase # > /help # > /tools # > /model claude-opus-4-6 # > refactor the database layer # > /cost # > /exit ``` ### CLI Options ```bash occ [options] [prompt] Options: -m, --model Model to use (default: claude-sonnet-4-6) -p, --print Print mode (non-interactive, output only) --permission-mode Permission mode: default, auto, plan, acceptEdits, bypassPermissions, dontAsk --system-prompt Override system prompt --add-dir Additional CLAUDE.md directory --max-turns Maximum conversation turns --allowedTools Comma-separated allowed tools --disallowedTools Comma-separated denied tools --output-format Output: text, json, stream-json -v, --verbose Verbose output -d, --debug Debug mode --version Show version -h, --help Show help ``` ### Examples ```bash # Use a different model occ -m claude-opus-4-6 "design a database schema for a blog" # Print mode (for piping) occ -p "list all functions in src/" > functions.txt # Plan mode (read-only, no edits) occ --permission-mode plan "review the security of auth.js" # Restrict tools occ --allowedTools "Read,Glob,Grep" "find all API endpoints" # With custom system prompt occ --system-prompt "You are a senior Go developer" "review main.go" ``` --- ## 🔧 Interactive Commands 40 slash commands available in REPL mode: | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `/help` | Show all commands | | `/model ` | Switch model mid-conversation | | `/tools` | List available tools | | `/tokens` | Show current token usage | | `/cost` | Show session cost estimate | | `/compact` | Compact context window | | `/undo` | Undo last file edit | | `/clear` | Clear conversation history | | `/doctor` | Check API connectivity + health | | `/fast` | Toggle fast mode (Haiku) | | `/effort ` | Set effort: low, medium, high, max | | `/resume [id]` | Resume a previous session | | `/sessions` | List saved sessions | | `/agents` | List custom agents | | `/skills` | List available skills | | `/hooks` | Show active hooks | | `/config` | Show current settings | | `/permissions` | Show permission mode | | `/mcp` | Show MCP server status | | `/memory` | Show memory usage | | `/exit` | Exit | --- ## 🔨 Tools 25 built-in tools matching Claude Code's tool system: | Tool | Description | |------|-------------| | **Bash** | Execute shell commands (sandboxed) | | **Read** | Read files with line numbers | | **Edit** | Replace strings in files | | **Write** | Create/overwrite files | | **Glob** | Find files by pattern | | **Grep** | Search file contents (regex) | | **LS** | List directory contents | | **Agent** | Spawn sub-agents | | **WebFetch** | Fetch URL content | | **WebSearch** | Web search | | **TodoWrite** | Task management | | **NotebookEdit** | Edit Jupyter notebooks | | **MultiEdit** | Atomic multi-file edits | | **ToolSearch** | Discover deferred tools | | **AskUser** | Prompt user for input | | **Skill** | Invoke a skill | | **SendMessage** | Agent team messaging | | **CronCreate/Delete/List** | Scheduled tasks | | **EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree** | Git worktree isolation | | **RemoteTrigger** | Remote execution | | **LSP** | Language server protocol | | **ReadMcpResource** | Read MCP resources | --- ## ⚙️ Configuration ### Settings Create `.claude/settings.json` in your project or `~/.claude/settings.json` globally: ```json { "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6", "permissions": { "defaultMode": "auto" }, "hooks": { "PreToolUse": [{ "matcher": "Bash", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "echo 'Running bash...'" }] }] }, "autoCompactEnabled": true, "alwaysThinkingEnabled": true } ``` Settings are loaded from 4 sources (in priority order): 1. `.claude/settings.local.json` (local, gitignored) 2. `.claude/settings.json` (project, shared) 3. `~/.claude/settings.json` (user global) 4. Managed policy (enterprise) ### CLAUDE.md Create a `CLAUDE.md` in your project root to customize behavior: ```markdown # Project Rules - Always use TypeScript - Follow TDD - Keep files under 500 lines ``` CLAUDE.md files are loaded from: `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` → parent directories → project root → `.claude/CLAUDE.md`. ### Custom Agents Create `.claude/agents/reviewer.md`: ```markdown --- name: reviewer description: Code review specialist model: claude-sonnet-4-6 tools: [Read, Glob, Grep] --- You are a thorough code reviewer. Check for bugs, security issues, and style. ``` ### Skills Create `.claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md`: ```markdown --- name: deploy description: Deploy to production --- 1. Run tests: npm test 2. Build: npm run build 3. Deploy: ./scripts/deploy.sh ``` Invoke with `/deploy` in the REPL. --- ## 🔐 Multi-Provider Support Adapters exist for Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible endpoints and Google. Installed-package E2E covers Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible tool roundtrips; Google is not covered by that gate. # Claude Code CLI

A command-line interface for interacting with Claude AI.

## Installation

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code.git
cd claude-code

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Make the CLI executable
chmod +x cli.mjs

# Link the package globally (optional)
npm link
```

## Usage

```bash
# Show help
claude --help

# Show version
claude --version

# Start a conversation with Claude
claude

# Enable debug mode
claude --debug
```

## Project Structure

- `cli.mjs` - Main entry point
- `src/` - Source code
  - `index.mjs` - Main application initialization
  - `cli/` - CLI-related modules
    - `app.mjs` - Main application flow
    - `commands.mjs` - Command handlers
    - `parse-args.mjs` - Command-line argument parsing
  - `terminal/` - Terminal UI modules
    - `ui.mjs` - Terminal UI utilities
  - `api/` - API client modules
    - `client.mjs` - Claude API client
  - `git/` - Git integration modules
    - `git.mjs` - Git utilities
  - `config/`- Configuration modules
    - `constants.mjs` - Constants and configuration
    - `paths.mjs` - Path utilities
    - `env.mjs` - Environment variable loader
  - `auth/` - Authentication modules
    - `auth.mjs` - Authentication utilities
  - `wasm/` - WebAssembly UI modules
    - `index.mjs` - WASM UI entry point
    - `ui-components.mjs` - UI components
    - `layout-engine.mjs` - Layout engine
    - `terminal-renderer.mjs` - Terminal renderer
    - `yoga-loader.mjs` - Yoga WASM loader
    - `conversation-ui.mjs` - Conversation UI
  - `utils/` - Utility modules
    - `file.mjs` - File utilities
    - `search.mjs` - Search utilities

## Development

### Adding a new command

1. Add the command handler to `src/cli/commands.mjs`
2. Update the `COMMANDS` object with the new command
3. Implement the command handler function

### Adding a new UI component

1. Add the component class to `src/wasm/ui-components.mjs`
2. Extend the `UIComponent` class
3. Implement the required methods
